The level-2 anchor requires core units to address AI capabilities AND limitations/ethics; the core carries data and cyber-security ethics (a core course titled 'Databases and Ethical Data', and assessed privacy/ethics outcomes in core Advanced Cyber Security), but not AI. Ambiguity between 1 and 2 — created by reading C3 broadly as digital governance rather than AI — resolved downward per the scoring-direction rule.
